text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre, you...!
YOU ABSOLUTE IDIOOOOOT——!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
!?
...From over there...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... Ngh, Duramente-san!?
Did you... just hear that...?!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Uwaah, uwaah...!
...Th-This is so utterly embarrassing...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No... I should be the one apologizing.
However... I must admit, I was surprised.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Whenever I see you during independent practice, you are always single-mindedly devoted to your training.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: As if reaching for a distant light, your run is straightforward—fueled by a burning passion.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Therefore, I assumed you were like me... without a shred of hesitation regarding your path.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Actually, it's the exact opposite.
Hard work is the only thing I've got, so I'm just desperately struggling...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: The one who's actually similar to you, Duramente-san, isn't me, but rather—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (...Wait, no way! Duramente-san isn't tyrannical like that at all!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Um... You're in the middle of roadwork, right?
Care to run back to the academy together?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, Hachimi!
Duramente-san, want to take a break?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Here you go!
Hehe, consider it hush money for earlier!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: No... Even without this, I had no intention of speaking a word of it to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No, hush money is just an excuse...
What I mean is, this is the real charm of roadwork!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
You know, like taking a detour on your way home from lessons.
It's just like that!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Ah... Detours are part of enjoying time with friends, rather than serving a specific objective—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Indeed, Crown has said something similar before.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Exactly.
...—Wait, isn't yours the soft & mild flavor?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Mine is hard & rich.
Would you like to swap?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes, I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
This is... quite sweet.
Almost pure honey.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
You just crave that punch of sweetness every once in a while, ya know!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: —Well then. Now that we've had plenty of rest and drunk something sweet...

text_block_list.name: Shion & Dura
text_block_list.text:
We've gotta burn off what we drank!
We must burn off what we drank.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Heh... As expected, our approach to training is identical.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, we're fellow regulars at independent training, after all.
—Alright, shall we get going!
In front of the school gates, I run into Win Variation and the others returning from their roadwork. In their hands, they're holding cups of "Hachimi Drink."
choice_data_list: Hachimi isn't really suited for hydration...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
We sure did! Sorry about that!
I'm the one who dragged Duramente-san along!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I apologize. However, I cannot disclose the circumstances.
...It is a secret.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes. But rest assured, we did nothing to compromise the dignity of the academy.
Since they called it a secret, pressing the matter felt tasteless. Looking at their smiles, it's clear they have nothing to feel guilty about.
choice_data_list: If it's a secret, then I guess it can't be helped.
If it's a secret, then I suppose it can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ! What a kind Trainer...! Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, are you airheaded by any chance? Now I kinda feel bad instead...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: The truth is, we took a little detour. So here, consider this hush money!
choice_data_list: I see. Thanks for being honest.

text_block_list.text: There is no need to scold the two who owned up to it themselves. Accepting the juice, I head over to the vending machine.
choice_data_list: Here, consider this hush money for accepting the hush money.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Hush money on top of hush money, is it?
Understood, I shall accept it.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Oh, Duramente-san, you really get it! Well then, let's gladly enjoy this!
